dict.string: Open Remote connects directly to your LG TV on your Wi‑Fi network. Nothing leaves your home network.
The microphone is used only while you give a voice command, to turn it into a TV action.
Air Mouse uses your device's motion sensors to move the pointer on your TV.
Choose photos and videos to show on your TV. They are streamed directly over your Wi‑Fi and never uploaded anywhere.
Speech recognition turns your voice command into a TV action. When your iPhone supports it, recognition happens on-device.
